payload.entry: Implemented Bob-span-driven draft styling: drawer titles use the section color and semibold monospaced font; delimiters use tertiary ink away from the caret and primary ink when touched; repaint clears inherited font attributes. Added a portable CaptureCore drawer span adapter for subsequent typing phases. Verified: Athena just portable-check passed (2,785 tests, 1 skipped); Mac scratch Scripts/bundle.sh and just typecheck-tests passed. Exact-SHA Scripts/macos-ci-check remains required before close.

Gate diagnosis: mac typecheck failed for real — DrawerHeaderDesignTests.testRenderDrawerHeaders called throwing edgeRows() inside the VStack ViewBuilder (error at line 59) which cascaded to a key-path inference error at line 80. Fixed in c2dd7fbf by hoisting let edge = try edgeRows() above the builder; just typecheck-tests now PASS on all 4 macOS targets on rebased HEAD. Pre-existing script bug (not a product defect): /tmp/bob-cli-ph-8-1-2-gates.sh wraps the mac ssh in GNU timeout, which does not exist on macOS — reran those steps without timeout per AGENTS.md. Pushed c2dd7fbf (rebased onto b422fbdc draft-styling); docs-check passed in the gate run; macos-ci-check still to run.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Diagnose macOS 26 SwiftPM Test-step fatalError during test-target compilation; reproduced on pre-change clean base 4d9e845 (CI 45753263190) and styling snapshot acfbfe9 (CI 45755244484), with no test name or hang sample and Build/Lint passing.

Verified styling: Athena just portable-check passed (2,785 tests, 1 skipped); macOS scratch Scripts/bundle.sh and just typecheck-tests passed; exact-SHA CI passed Lint and Build. CI Test ended in fatalError without a test name or hang sample; the same Test failure is present on pre-change clean base 4d9e845 (run 45753263190), recorded as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Epic-symbol check found no entries.

CI 45756431583 (SHA c2dd7fbf) failed 2 tests, both real assertion bugs, fixed in 5d50d5a6 and pushed (master==origin/master). (1) DrawerHeaderDesignTests expected transfer destination '› Perf Budget' but capture-transfer-drawer-merge.json names merges[0].target.drawer FUTURE WORK and containerLabel renders it verbatim — expectation corrected to '› FUTURE WORK' with comment; fixture untouched. (2) b422 (closed bead 8.1.3) paints the caret-touched drawer delimiter as bare .primary while its own test expects .labelColor; NSColor(Color.primary) is a customDynamic wrapper that never == .labelColor, so both full-ink asserts failed. Changed to Color(nsColor: .labelColor), matching the paired tertiaryLabelColor branch; no visual change. Neither failure involves preview-tray behavior. Mac scratch typecheck did NOT complete: rsync+bundle.sh passed on the scratch copy, but the just typecheck-tests ssh hung and the mac then went offline (tailscale: offline, last seen ~8m). CI Build step will compile; report macOS targets scratch-unverified. Scratch copy /tmp/bob-mac-typecheck-8-1-2 left on mac for cleanup. -r follow-up

Visual review of drawer render fixtures from CI run 45756431583 (SHA c2dd7fbf; my 5d50d5a6 changes no rendering — string expectation + same-ink color form only). Inspected 10/16 drawer-headers PNGs: edge+real x 760/620 x light/dark/high-contrast (incl. hc-dark real, 620 narrow real+edge). All sane: outline tray distinct from checkbox/diamond, semibold verbatim titles, muted empty Drafts, removed Old Drawer struck+dimmed, legacy FUTURE WORK all-caps preserved, long title wraps sanely at both widths, no raw ** on drawer rows, Just-bold keeps its stars as a verbatim non-drawer line, requirement diamond keeps precedence, no bold/strike leakage. Remaining 6 PNGs are appearance/width recombinations of verified rows. Hashes: /tmp/drawer-png-hashes.txt (also in run 45756431583 render-fixtures artifact). No defects; no re-gate needed for visuals. -r follow-up

preview-tray done: BlockDiffCard renders Bob-annotated drawer header as outline-tray SF Symbol plus semibold verbatim title, muted when empty, with accessible labels; light/dark/high-contrast fixtures sane. Commits 4d9e845e (tray+verbatim), c2dd7fbf (hoist throwing edgeRows out of ViewBuilder), 5d50d5a6 (fix DrawerHeaderDesignTests verbatim expectation to FUTURE WORK and delimiter full-ink to Color(nsColor:.labelColor)). CI green on base 5d50d5a6ddf46b4aa35efefbb83739734b6094f2 (snapshot fab1f219fcbc089d5e02580be0916e7a233c8394), run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/45761321912 : Lint ok, Build ok, Test ok (incl.
